name: Financial Item Parameters 1
definition: Regroups identification parameters for trade items.

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Unique identification of this item relative to the issuing party.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date of creation of the item.

RelatedItem.name: Related Item
RelatedItem.definition: Identifier of related items, for example an assignment or an advice.

DocumentPurpose.name: Document Purpose
DocumentPurpose.definition: Specifies the function of the document related to the item.

LanguageCode.name: Language Code
LanguageCode.definition: Language used for textual information in item.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Party that issued this list of items.

Recipient.name: Recipient
Recipient.definition: Receiving party of this list of items.

Buyer.name: Buyer
Buyer.definition: Party that acts as buyer of the goods or services referred to by the financial item.

Seller.name: Seller
Seller.definition: Party that acts as seller of the goods or services referred to by the financial item.

GoverningContract.name: Governing Contract
GoverningContract.definition: Reference to contract that governs the exchange of the message.

LegalContext.name: Legal Context
LegalContext.definition: Rules and laws governing the item.

DebitAccount.name: Debit Account
DebitAccount.definition: Defines the account debited for charges (or credited for reimbursement).

CreditAccount.name: Credit Account
CreditAccount.definition: Defines the account credited for charges (or debited for reimbursement).

TradeMarket.name: Trade Market
TradeMarket.definition: Identification of the geographical environment of the trade market.
